text_block_list.text:
With the Japanese Derby fast approaching...
An especially large number of Umamusume had suffered setbacks this year, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...!
More! Trainer, one more rep!

Jungle Pocket was distinctly different
from the hypersensitive, delicate Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Running this much and not even being fazed...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Damn right. My toughness and the road I've walked are different from Tachyon and the others. After all—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I've been sprinting through the no-rules asphalt jungle,
after all!
And then, the day of the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My path was certainly cut short that day.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Those feelings are passed on, right here today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well Pokke, do your best.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Right, Fuji-san! With the running style you taught me, I'm definitely gonna...!

From Fuji Kiseki to Jungle Pocket.
That running style is passed down――

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
Things have gone smoothly so far.
Without peaking too early, I'll bring her to top form right for the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
I managed to pace myself well.
With this, everything should be just fine.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's all thanks to you, bro!

text_block_list.text:
From brother to Trainer.
The conditioning and care techniques were passed down—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
From Umamusume to Umamusume, from person to person,
there are things entrusted to one another, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
From "us" to "all of you,"
there is something we wish to entrust.
choice_data_list: Something you want to entrust to me? What would that be...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a "promise."
A promise unfulfilled from a day long past...

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Let's win the Derby, Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That promise from that day, buried in sorrow for so long—
I now entrust it to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We couldn't do it.
But if it's you girls, surely...!
choice_data_list: ...Yeah! I'll definitely make it come true!

text_block_list.text:
I won't let my brother's and Fuji Kiseki's sadness
go to waste. Ever.
By channeling that grief into today's race, the two of them will finally find their reward.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Jungle Pocket.
What incredible fighting spirit. That's the stance of someone determined to win!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Today, her rival Agnes Tachyon was nowhere to be seen
on the podium. That is...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"They're watching over you from the stands.
Can you live up to their cheers!?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what is it?
Am I not supposed to be here?
choice_data_list: No, I wouldn't really call it cheering...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How rude. Yet, you've hit the bullseye.
Necessary—yes, it is necessary. Because—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Because my race isn't over just yet.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they can do it, I'm sure of it.
Those two have something that we never had.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Things that never existed?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, the one thing we lacked.
That was...”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's "us."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There was no Umamusume to give me advice.
Nor was there anyone to advise you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But right now, Pokke has me.
And Trainer-san has you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This Derby... lies along the path
forged by our hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The depth of the feelings she has built up is on another level.
That's why—I'm sure she'll deliver a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan, I look forward to working with you!
I might not be as fast as Tachyon-chan yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dants, take more pride in yourself.
No matter what happened along the way, you made it to the Derby, too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That's right, we have the strength and the reason to run.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wanted to come here.
And so many couldn't make it.
All the more reason—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We... have to run.
With everything inside us boiling over.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Fuji-san, watch me.
Your brilliance that awakened me.
The debt of gratitude I owe you for guiding me...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (With today's run, I'll pay it back for sure!)
